title: ABOUT 300 FANS, A WHATSAPP GROUP, SIX CONFEDERATIONS: THIS WINGER'S CV IS WILD
description:
Laos, Nepal, Malta, Angola, Tahiti. That's one winger's CV, and it reads like a travel diary.

Sergio Barboza has played for clubs in all six confederations. ESPN says he's the first outfield player to do it in FIFA-affiliated leagues. Not a bad way to fill a passport.

In September he landed in Tahiti with no club. About 300 fans were paying $6 a month to back him, and they voted on his decisions in a WhatsApp group. Three hundred assistant managers, basically. Then he made his debut: two goals, an assist and a 5-1 win. Four goals and four assists in five games, unpaid apart from his room. A cyclone then doubled his flight home to nearly $3,000. Next stop: Africa.

Would you hand your biggest decisions to a WhatsApp group? Honest answers only.
